scope: Automatic archival/release of completed BLOCKED PRE freeze only; no admission, production mutation, contract change, model substitution or numbered advancement
preconditions: exact approved Astra/xhigh and pinned confined runtime/probe are verified
complete retained raw stream and final raw FAIL report; wrapper BLOCKED due failed inspection events
normal release API explicitly refuses invalid raw evidence
all original shared/outer raw bytes and hashes retained immutably before interpretation
actual bound reviewer termination and absence of concurrent owning writer are proved
only the exact byte-matched freeze marker is archived under its own immutable common run
after-release candidate/index/HEAD snapshot remains equal to the original freeze
permittedAfterRelease: record immutable FAIL/BLOCKED evidence and truthful branch status; authorized feature-only checkpoint publication
one fresh complete PRE after a diagnosed preparation error is addressed without approved package changes
retryBound: At most one further full PRE using the prepared deterministic source tour. Another failed attempt stops automatic retries and reports the actual limitation.
exclusions: no recovery on candidate/packet/request/control drift, unavailable termination, missing raw or runtime/model/confinement failure
no invalid PASS admission or rewriting historical verdicts
no source/test/production change before clean PRE
no changes to releaseReviewFreeze or verifyRawReview to bypass the gate
no account/global settings, host grants, main/foreign owner changes or force push
